summary: RedCloud Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a private placement of 74,000 ordinary shares to CEO Justin Floyd at $2.50 per share, an aggregate $185,000, disclosed as a substantial premium to the September 21, 2026 close. The price was settled by offsetting company liabilities owed to Floyd under a set-off agreement, closing September 22, 2026, with no cash proceeds and issuance under Section 4(a)(2). The funding is liquidity relief from an insider rather than a third-party special situation; no advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock is stated. Watch dilution, related-party terms, and any further insider financings.
